meta.source_title: University of Cebu College of Medicine Foundation, Inc. - Level 2 Calendar of Activities for SY 2026-2027 (Second Bimonthly)
review_notes: Term window for this schedule is 2026-10-12 to 2026-12-05 (update term_start/term_end in the editor's Term & settings when you make it live).
Untimed items (Saturday Psychiatry lectures/exams, PrevMed afternoon lectures, some Pathology/PD exams, Research items, BLS) have no printed clock time and are entered as all-day (confidence medium).
MICRO Fridays print the quiz/exam and the lecture/case-report with the same 1:30 PM start; split into back-to-back events to avoid overlaps (Oct 23, Oct 30, Nov 27).
Nov 6 MICRO Long Exam 3 had no explicit time; placed in the 1:30-3:30 PM slot (confidence medium).
Legal Medicine and OSCE are not in the subject list; filed under OTHER. BLS/Hx-taking/guided-demo are filed under PD.
All week headers read 2026 and match their weekdays - no year corrections needed.
